slides.title: The Monthly Town Hall connects everyone to the plan.
slides.headline: The Monthly Town Hall connects everyone to the plan.
slides.support: 30 to 45 minutes. Everyone. The CEO owns it.
body: QHAG progress: where are we on the #1 priority, and what can everyone do to help?
Financial transparency: what is working and what is not
One thing we can do as a company to improve our financial health
notes: Rate the Town Hall too: is it running, is it working, and what would you change?
Values recognition: name someone in front of the whole company. Name the value. Name what they did.
This is the only meeting where the whole company hears the same thing at the same time.
Financial transparency builds the financial literacy of the whole team.
Show the Team View at a Town Hall only when it changes.
